- Daily ticket price for an adult: $30
- Daily ticket price for a student: $14

\[ \text{Cost for 1 student} = 1 \, \text{student} \times 14 \, \text{\$/student} \]

Thus, for one visit:

\[ \text{Total cost for one visit} = (4 \times 30) + (1 \times 14) \]

For 5 visits, we calculate as follows:

\[ \text{Total cost for 5 visits} = 5 \times \left((4 \times 30) + (1 \times 14)\right) \]

# Group size

# Total visits

# Calculate total cost for 5 visits
